item.title: Scrapling: Adaptive Python Web Scraping That Survives UI Redesigns
item.description: Scrapling tracks moved DOM elements automatically when websites change class names, combining anti-bot stealth, proxy rotation, and MCP agent integration.

item.title: 10. Spider 72%: The Dataset, Not the Model, Shapes the Error Profile
item.description: Switching to Pro actually dropped accuracy by 8%p. I categorized 19 errors into 6 types and ran the same pipeline on Spider. The distributions were completely different. DB characteristics determine the error profile more than the model does.

item.title: Unexpected Limits When Extracting Web Pages to Markdown with defuddle
item.description: Testing defuddle for RAG web ingestion shows sharp quality swings: non-semantic HTML mixes ads into body text, while client-rendered pages drop content.
